title: Experiment logs and architecture notes
description: Document hypotheses, measured evidence and architecture decisions with reviewable ADR status, tradeoffs and rollback plans.
objectives: Record a falsifiable hypothesis with controlled conditions
Separate observations from inferences and generalizations
Write a consistent Architecture Decision Record (ADR)
Document tradeoffs and a concrete rollback condition
rubric: I recorded a falsifiable experiment, controls and limitations.
I created an ADR with explicit status and rollback instructions.
I passed decision format and missing-field regression tests.
